facts.text: Graduates of the Practical Nursing diploma program enrolling in the Bachelor of Science in Nursing program can receive a need-based alumni grant of up to $7,500.

sources.title: Financial Aid & FAFSA | Nursing School Utah & Idaho | Eagle Gate College
sources.quote: This grant is available to graduates of Eagle Gate or Provo College's pre-licensure Practical Nursing (PN) Diploma program who enroll in Eagle Gate or Provo College's Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) program.

sources.title: Financial Aid & FAFSA | Nursing School Utah & Idaho | Eagle Gate College
sources.quote: It is awarded based on financial need and requires completion of the FAFSA. The maximum grant amount is $7,500, awarded proportionately each semester.
